name: SHENANDOAH BARREL SAUNA
description: The Shenandoah is the largest and most deluxe of our entire family of Barrel Saunas.  A changing room adjoins the sauna room, which is large enough to seat up to 8 persons, providing convenience and comfort to this unique barrel sauna.  The Shenandoah features custom slatted benches, removable flat flooring sections, and can be outfitted with an electric or wood burning sauna stove.  The Shenandoah delivers unmatched size, beauty and function to the outdoor sauna experience.
